An '''atmospheric converter''' was a component of a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter's]] [[Life support/Legends|life support]] system. Fighters such as [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] did not carry an atmospheric converter, instead requiring the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] to carry a personal converter. The converter was essentially a miniature recycling plant.<ref name="SWS" />
